name: historic-eiopa-yield-curve
title_zh: EIOPA利率曲线十年全量随查随答
tagline_zh: 不用翻官网、不用拼CSV，问任意国家、期限、日期的即期利率，或整条曲线、远期、贴现因子、压力情景。
tagline_en: Skip the website and CSV wrangling. Ask any spot rate, full curve, forward, discount factor, or stress.
desc_en: Answer any question about historic EIOPA risk-free rate (RFR) yield curves - a spot rate for a country and tenor at a reference date, a whole term structure, a tenor through time, countries side by side, implied forwards, discount factors, the Solvency II stressed curves, or curve parameters (UFR, LLP, alpha, CRA, VA). It carries the full published history with it - every monthly release since 201
why_zh: 内置完整历史发布，免去你手动下载、清洗、对齐的脏活；对隐含远期和压力曲线的计算逻辑有明确实现。
why_en: Ships with the entire release history, so no manual download or cleaning. Implied forwards and stressed curves are computed, not.
limit_zh: 只覆盖EIOPA公布的RFR曲线及其衍生量，不含其他利率源或自定义假设；需要联网获取最新发布。
limit_en: Only EIOPA RFR curves and derived metrics; no other rate sources or custom assumptions. Needs internet for latest releases; local data ends at a.
title_en: Full EIOPA yield curve history, ask anything
